title: Switch The Meter
style: Jazz with shifting time signatures, swung walking bass, brushed drums, upright piano comping, and bold horn hits; verse rides in 5/4 with lean phrasing, pre-chorus tightens into 7/8, chorus opens to a strong 4/4 lift, bridge drops to sparse bass and ride cymbal before a final syncopated chorus. Close-mic vocal with crisp doubles, scat ad-libs, and playful delay throws on key lines. Bright, punchy mix with warm room air and little ride-cymbal sparkles between phrases., jazz, motivational
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
When the clock starts biting
And your knees go weak
Take the crooked count
And make it speak

One two three, I’m moving
Four five, still I rise
Six and seven, I’m grinning
Got that spark in my eyes

[Pre-Chorus]
If the ground keeps changing
Let it move, let it roll
I can lean into the chaos
Keep the pocket, keep control

[Chorus]
Switch the meter, switch the meter
I can dance through the change
Switch the meter, switch the meter
Keep my heart in the frame
(Keep my heart in the frame)
Switch the meter, switch the meter
I’m still rising all the same

[Verse 2]
Missed the first downbeat
Then I found my feet
Riding off the questions
On a backbeat street

Every odd turn teaches
How to land on time
Every broken pattern
Makes a sharper line

[Pre-Chorus]
If the floor keeps tilting
I don’t fold, I don’t fall
I hear trouble turning
Into something I can call

[Chorus]
Switch the meter, switch the meter
I can dance through the change
Switch the meter, switch the meter
Keep my heart in the frame
(Keep my heart in the frame)
Switch the meter, switch the meter
I’m still rising all the same

[Bridge]
Let the count break open
Let the horns run wide
I was made for motion
I was built to glide

No easy lane, no clean line
Still I stay in tune
When the whole room shifts shape
I lift higher than the moon
(higher than the moon)

[Final Chorus]
Switch the meter, switch the meter
I can dance through the change
Switch the meter, switch the meter
Keep my heart in the frame
(Keep my heart in the frame)
Switch the meter, switch the meter
I’m still rising all the same
Switch the meter, switch the meter
I’m still shining anyway
